## Overview

This session explores R's data-visualisation package **ggplot2**. It answers
three questions: why ggplot (how does it differ from base plotting)? How do you
make plots with ggplot2? And how do you customise and modify them?

## What you'll learn

- The grammar of graphics and its syntax
- How to build a visualisation from scratch
- The geometric components of a graph
- How to produce different plot types (scatter plots, boxplots, barplots, …)
- What faceting is, and how to apply it
- How to modify a plot's aesthetics (themes, axis labels, stats, colours, …)
- How to combine and save plots as publishable figures

## Prerequisites

Please have **R** and **RStudio** installed, plus the ggplot2 package
(`install.packages("ggplot2")`). The tutorial uses the publicly available
[Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) dataset
(`install.packages("palmerpenguins")`).
